title: Back melanoma WLE
brief: A melanoma on the back, 10 mm, Breslow 0.8 mm after excision biopsy: wide local excision with a 1 cm margin. The defect is 30 mm across, in thick skin under tension.
goals: Mark the 1 cm margin and design a long ellipse along the skin tension lines.
Excise, undermine, and close the long wound without snapping sutures.

approach.text: A long fusiform ellipse, about 3:1 (here some 90 mm), along the relaxed skin tension lines, with undermining on both sides before closing. Close with strong sutures from the middle outwards.

tips.lesion: Wide local excision: 10 mm from the lesion's edge all round.
tips.closed: Close the full length: many sutures, middle outwards.
tips.tension: Undermine both sides widely (Undermine tool) before closing, and keep the ellipse along the RSTL.
tips.dog_ears: Make the ellipse long enough (3:1) or remove the dog-ears at the ends.
tips.sutures: Back skin is under tension: use thicker thread (3-0) and undermine.
